_comment: Which model answers for each role. Configuration, not code (D-0005). The verifier must be a different family from the builder and from the builder's fallback, and has no fallback of its own (FR-G6). A fallback is what Gnomon switches to when the primary endpoint fails, for example on a 429. The cockpit assistant answers from a snapshot, so a local model is enough; it never acts. The `local` endpoint is an OpenAI-compatible server on this machine (llama.cpp's llama-server listens on 8080 by default). A machine's own endpoints go in kernel/routing.local.json, which is not tracked and is merged over this file (docs/guides/local-models.md).
